# Trimmed from a real link of the bare F405 profile (rev ebc6bf9-dirty,
# 2026-09-19), and trimmed to the two parts that matter to a reader of it:
#
#   * the Memory Configuration block, which is the linker's own account of what
#     the part has, written from linker/stm32f405rg.ld;
#   * a window of the memory map proper, taken from the `.iplt` rows, because
#     those are the rows a parser that does not stop at the end of the block
#     reads as regions - `.iplt` has a length of zero, and dividing by it is
#     how tools/image_report.py first failed.
#
# The link's own --print-memory-usage line, which tools/image_report.py has to
# agree with byte for byte, was:
#
#   FLASH:      104500 B         1 MB      9.97%
#   RAM:         78452 B       128 KB     59.85%
#   CCM:             0 GB        64 KB      0.00%
#
# Regenerate: make BOARD=AERIALKIT_F405 OUT=build size, then take the block.
Memory Configuration

FLASH            0x08000000         0x00100000         xr
RAM              0x20000000         0x00020000         xrw
CCM              0x10000000         0x00010000         xrw
*default*        0x00000000         0xffffffff
